summary: Slice 1 of 3: gave the always-visible footer one sidebar toggle that shares paneCollapsed and the same toggleSidebar handler as Ctrl+B, so the two cannot disagree and the footer stays on every screen (R6). Wired that toggle in App and made opening an app start calm: it now selects the app's first terminal (or clears the tab when the app has no terminals), so a console or git drawer left open on an earlier visit is not reopened, while a running console stays mounted and running (R9, A2). Expanded the app-level palette command list to the global commands and the commands that only exist while an app is open, and added working Reset layout and Hide console handlers that hide rather than close (R7/R8). The saved layout is still only the existing td.sidebarCollapsed key with its try/catch fallback; no per-app drawer/console state or new key is written. Added tests in AppFooter.test.tsx, App.test.tsx, App.features.test.tsx, App.shortcuts.test.tsx and a new App.layout.test.tsx, and cleared localStorage between cases so saved sidebar state cannot leak. Deferred to the other build slices (files not touched here): the cmdk palette swap with No shortcut notes and disabled reasons, the ConsoleNav Hide console button, controlled GitBar open/onOpenChange plus the git-tools palette toggle, package.json/package-lock.json and the plan doc. Verified with npm run lint, the targeted vitest files, the full suite (43 files, 414 tests pass) and npm run build. Slice 2 of the revision-2 build. Added cmdk 1.1.1 (MIT, exact) for the command palette and recorded it in package.json/package-lock.json; it lives only in the lazy CommandPalette chunk, not the entry chunk. CommandPalette now renders the list with cmdk (shouldFilter=false keeps the existing case-insensitive name filter), keeps each action a real named button with its real shortcut or a visible 'No shortcut' note, shows a visible disabled reason for commands that cannot run now, and keeps the 'No commands match.' empty result, choose-runs-once-and-closes and Escape. ConsoleNav gained a Hide console control that is disabled with a visible reason when the console is the only workspace. GitBar gained optional controlled open/onOpenChange props while uncontrolled callers keep their old behaviour. App.tsx now keeps gitToolsOpen as controlled state: openApp and Reset layout collapse the git tools, the palette offers Show/Hide git tools, Close git drawer and a Hide console item that is disabled with a reason in an app with no terminals. Added/updated A1 characterization tests plus R7/R8 tests. npm run lint, npm test (420 passed) and npm run build all pass. Finished slice 3 of the revision-2 tidy-up on top of the already-built AppShell, footer toggle, cmdk palette, ConsoleNav Hide control and controlled GitBar. Added the revision-2 plan content to docs/ui-tidy-up-plan.md (sections 11-16: footer toggle, full palette command list with real shortcuts or No shortcut, hide/reopen table, the single remembered td.sidebarCollapsed field, package decisions with the in-house reasons, and a revision-2 state check kept outside the S/P/D/B inventory rows so the R1 plan tests still pass). package.json/package-lock.json already pin cmdk 1.1.1 (MIT, React ^18||^19); src/test/setup.ts was left unchanged because the existing observer/scroll shims already satisfy cmdk. Added an R10 test proving the palette is cmdk (a [cmdk-root] element), cmdk is pinned in the manifest, and the palette module is not evaluated while App is imported. Stabilised one App.shortcuts focus assertion with waitFor after a full-run timing flake. npm run lint, npm run build and the full suite (43 files, 422 tests) pass; cmdk is emitted only in dist/assets/CommandPalette-*.js, not the entry chunk.
